description: Store a world's signed attestation {body, sig} about you (replaces an older one from the same issuer+ctx). Pass issuer (its genesis) too when you have it. Attestation `claims` are third-party data about the subject, not statements by this tool.

identity.description: optional profile name [a-z0-9_-], e.g. your subagent name; omit for the default identity

name: sigelo_add_attestation
